item.title: CKB Talk Daily Brief - 2026-09-15
item.description: ## 今日发生了什么 今天论坛整体较平静，最近 24 小时可见的主要动态集中在 noir-ckb 方向讨论和 Pocket Node 移动端维护更新上 [S01, S02]。在 noir-ckb 方向检查帖中，matt_ckb 回复 @xiaomao，称这项工作很有意思，并提到 Battleship 被用作示例展示实际效果 [S01]。Pocket Node 则发布了 v1.8.4，已在 Google Play 和 GitHub 上线，唯一变化是目标 Android 16 [S02]。 ## 重点话题 noir-ckb 方向讨论获得回应：matt_ckb 表示 @xiaomao 的工作很有意思，并以 Battleship 作为实际示例展示其效果 [S01]。 matt_ckb 在回复中认为，把 zk 加入 lock/type 功能会打开以前未被考虑过的可能性 [S01]。 Pocket Node v1.8.4 发布：该 Android 轻客户端已在 Google Play 和 GitHub 上线，属于维护版本 [S02]。 这次 Pocket Node 更新的唯一变化是目标 Android 16（API level 36），以符合 Google Play 的平台要求 [S02]。 ## 值得继续跟进 noir-ckb 是否最终应该从 Noir circuits 生成 CKB Type Scripts，这一方向讨论后续是否会形成更明确的结论 [S01]。 zk 加入 lock/type 功能后可能带来哪些新设计或应用，值得继续观察 [S01]。 Pocket Node...

item.title: Direction check: should noir-ckb generate CKB Type Scripts from Noir circuits? (1 posts)
item.description: hi @xiaomao , this is very interesting work. Really glad to see you examining this and that you have put forth Battleship as an example to show it in action. I do think that adding zk to the lock/type functionality opens up things that were not considered before, reading your post is the first time I ever thought about being able to validate two different zk proofs (with different inputs) atomically on CKB. I am getting the sense that you have a strong grasp of what you’d like to accomplish here, but it does seem a little unclear on the surface. item.title: [DIS] Mobile-Ready CKB Light Client (Pocket Node) for Android (1 posts)
item.description: Pocket Node v1.8.4 is now available on Google Play and GitHub. This is a maintenance release. The one change is that the app now targets Android 16 (API level 36), which keeps it compliant with Google Play’s platform requirements going forward. There are no feature or behavior changes in this build: keys, wallets, sync settings, and balances are all unchanged from v1.8.3.
